main.description: Space policy that grants access based on a member list.

publicRead.description: If true, anyone may read the space. Otherwise, only members with read access.

publicWrite.description: If true, anyone may write to the space. Otherwise, only members with write access.

allowedApps.description: If set, only these apps may read the space.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the space.

publishMembers.description: Publish the member list as com.atproto.memberspace.member records in the space.
